before: Dependent text edits checked grapheme boundaries only after mapping back to raw native text. Removing an inline atom can join source code points into one proposed grapheme.
after: The private coordinator validates both proposed and native grapheme boundaries before publishing mapped text operations. An atom-removal plan cannot introduce an insertion or deletion inside the joined proposed grapheme.
reason: This adds a refusal guard to private coordinate lowering. It adds no native operation, transport field, persisted format, or public API.
